description: The creator's rules for brand deals: minimum rate per deliverable (cents), add-ons for paid ads and rush, declined categories, brief fields a brand must give, usage and payment limits, and the inbound caps. Every inquiry is checked against them (inquiry_log, the Work with me page, brand agents on /mcp/public); one that misses a rule is filtered and never reaches the creator. saved is false until the creator saves them once; only then is the Work with me page (work_url) open to brands.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
